en: Black‑and‑white view along a straight tree‑lined road in a semi‑rural area. On the left stands a large villa with steep tiled roof, dormers, and decorative timber details, enclosed by a fence. Telegraph or power poles run down the center of the road. On the right is a grassy verge and orchards or vineyards supported by wooden stakes. In the distance, on top of a terraced hillside covered with vines, there is a prominent hilltop pilgrimage complex or monastery with multiple towers and a central dome, dominating the skyline.
